title: What is my Patronus? Free Harry Potter Patronus quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Patronus quiz: answer 12 questions to find your Harry Potter Patronus, from stag, otter and wolf to hare, cat, horse, swan and phoenix. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Which silver guardian would burst from your wand? Answer 12 questions about courage, friendship and what you'd fight for to find your Patronus.
about: In the Harry Potter books by J.K. Rowling, the Patronus Charm ("Expecto Patronum") summons a silvery guardian that protects its caster against Dementors. A full Patronus takes the shape of an animal that reflects something deep about the witch or wizard who casts it, and it is powered by a happy memory. This quiz matches you with eight of them: stag, otter, wolf, hare, cat, horse, swan and phoenix.

Your result names your Patronus and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by J.K. Rowling, Warner Bros. or Wizarding World; the names and characters belong to their owners.

faq.q: Which Patronus animals can I get?
faq.a: Stag, otter, wolf, hare, cat, horse, swan and phoenix.

faq.q: Is one Patronus rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every animal appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: How do you cast a Patronus in the books?
faq.a: You hold a powerful happy memory in mind and say "Expecto Patronum". A weak attempt only gives a silvery mist; a strong one gives a full animal.
Yes. In the books, a Patronus can change after a great emotional event, such as falling deeply in love.

items.q: A friend is in trouble. What do you do first?
options: Step in front of them and take charge
Think up a clever way out, fast
Stay by their side, whatever it takes
Try something nobody else would think of

items.q: Your favorite way to spend a free afternoon:
options: A quiet window seat and a good book
Outdoors, as far as your legs will take you
By a lake with someone you love
Exploring somewhere old and full of history

items.q: Which compliment means the most to you?
options: You make everything look effortless
I always feel safe with you
You're always one step ahead
You're the most loyal person I know

items.q: Pick a class at wizarding school:
options: Divination
Flying lessons
Charms
Defense Against the Dark Arts

items.q: Something knocks you down. How do you get back up?
options: Slowly, but I come back stronger every time
I think of the people counting on me
With quiet dignity, head held high
I find something to laugh about

items.q: Your friends would describe you as…
options: Free-spirited and hard-working
Loyal, but slow to trust
Quirky and a little dreamy
Cool, sharp and independent
Losing control of a situation
Being forgotten
Failing to protect the people I love
Being forced to be like everyone else

items.q: Pick a magical creature to look after:
options: A huge three-headed dog with a soft heart
A shy unicorn
A winged horse
A curious little niffler
Do the heavy lifting without complaining
Quietly fix everyone's mistakes
Come up with the best ideas
End up leading, whether you meant to or not
Sunset over still water
Moonlight in an empty meadow
Sunrise, the start of something new
Midnight, when the house is quiet

items.q: What would you most like to be remembered for?
options: Never abandoning a friend
Rising again after every fall
Standing up for what's right
Living life on my own terms
Swimming, games and endless jokes with friends
Doing exactly what you like, alone
Wandering somewhere new with no plan
A romantic day with your favorite person

stag.name: Stag
stag.body: You are a natural protector: brave, steady and quietly noble. People feel safe around you, and you step up when things go wrong. Remember that leading doesn't mean carrying everything alone.

otter.name: Otter
otter.body: You are clever, curious and playful. You find the smart way through a problem and the joke in a hard day, and your friends love your quick mind. Let yourself rest; not everything needs solving at once.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.body: You are fiercely loyal and deeply private. You trust slowly, but once someone is in your pack, you'd do anything for them. Let the people you love see the softer side you keep hidden.

hare.name: Hare
hare.body: You are original, quick and a little dreamy. You see what others miss and don't mind being different. Trust your odd ideas: they're often the ones that work.

cat.name: Cat
cat.body: You are independent, observant and composed. You think before you act and rarely lose your cool, which makes people respect you. Let others in a little more; you don't always have to cope alone.

horse.name: Horse
horse.body: You are free-spirited, energetic and hard-working. You love open space and pull your weight without complaining. Choose your own path, and don't let anyone fence you in.

swan.name: Swan
swan.body: You are graceful, gentle and devoted. You stay calm on the surface even when you're working hard underneath, and you love deeply and for a long time. Make sure you receive as much care as you give.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.body: You are rare, resilient and wise beyond your years. Setbacks don't end your story; they start a new chapter. People are drawn to your hope. Share it, and let others help you rise too.
